name: Core Card & Rules Platform
contract: Complete declared catalog, identity mappings, versioned rules/errata/legality and certified effects/choices/visibility.

name: Actual Match Engine
contract: All listed actions/endings, clocks, durable commands, synchronization and recovery; no unauthorized state.

name: Deckbuilder
contract: Editing, search, statistics, imports, sharing and printing selection round-trip; separate format and ownership validation.

name: Sandbox / Lab Mode
contract: Ordinary unlocked Lab works and can earn eligible currency; manipulated experiments branch reproducibly and cannot affect economy/rank.

name: Player Collection
contract: Printing/finish holdings and history reconcile to ledger; completion/missing views have accurate denominators.

name: Virtual Product System
contract: Versioned products and documented slots; once-only committed grants with reveal/skip/bulk/resume and supported selected categories.

name: Progression & Economy
contract: XP/currency/inventory/cosmetic effects settle once; eligibility and selected acquisition model are tested and balanced.

name: Player Profile
contract: Privacy-aware identity, statistics, history, collection/tournament views, friends and blocking.

name: Matchmaking
contract: All selected queues/invites/match structures admit legal pinned decks; pair/cancel/rematch and privacy races resolve safely.

name: Ranked System
contract: Versioned ratings, seasons, leaderboards and rewards settle idempotently; abuse signals and history are reviewable.

name: Limited Formats
contract: Correct pools, products, picks/autopicks and format validation, with logs/export/reconnect and event integration.

name: AI Opponents
contract: Complete legal games at each advertised strength; viewer-safe inputs, resource limits, reproducibility and measured quality.

name: Tutorial & Learning System
contract: Every listed lesson/topic has cited, executable and regression-tested content with beginner usability evidence.

name: Rules Assistant
contract: Version-correct reason codes, citations, interaction explanations and uncertainty labels use viewer-authorized context.

name: Match History & Replay System
contract: Deterministic role-safe replay, history/controls/export/annotations and provenance-aware sandbox branching.

name: Post-Game Analytics
contract: Metrics recompute from immutable events; definitions, probability assumptions and privacy are documented.

name: Spectator System
contract: Authorized/delayed player, spectator, caster and judge views; delay survives reconnect and export.

name: Tournament Platform
contract: Registration/deck locks/pairings/tiebreaks/cuts/timers and corrections follow tested versioned policy with scoped judges.

name: Social Features
contract: Consent-based friends/presence/challenges/sharing and selected chat/groups; blocks/reports enforced server-side.

name: Card Encyclopedia
contract: Every declared identity/printing and sourced metadata/rulings/errata/relations with search, ownership and deck/Lab links.

name: Metagame & Competitive Data
contract: Reproducible segmented metrics, taxonomy and uncertainty/sample/bias disclosure; no private match data exposure.

name: Deck Discovery
contract: Discover/copy/bookmark and missing-card acquisition flows; unrestricted Lab available independent of ownership.

name: Achievements
contract: Event-derived progress and rewards idempotent; hidden criteria and badges/titles controlled.

name: Cosmetics
contract: Selected cosmetics earned/equipped/synced with provenance; clarity, accessibility and performance preserved.

name: Accessibility & User Experience
contract: Keyboard, semantic board, contrast/text/motion/audio/localization and actual desktop/tablet/phone acceptance evidence.

name: Notifications
contract: Correct recipient, dedupe, preferences/quiet hours/deep links and rotation warnings with channel fallback.

name: Content Management Backend
contract: Permissioned staging/versioning/diff/review/activation/rollback of content, scripts, assets, formats and economy configurations.

name: Card Implementation Testing
contract: Meaningful per-card/interaction/keyword/regression and invariant/replay/fuzz suites for all admitted content.

name: Game Integrity & Anti-Cheat
contract: Secure randomness, validated authority/visibility/clocks, abuse review and immutable investigation evidence.

name: Accounts & Infrastructure
contract: Verified recovery/guest/sync, load/versioning/backups/telemetry/maintenance and measured failure recovery.

name: Moderation & Administration
contract: Scoped cases/actions/appeals and audited grants/compensation/investigation; no unscoped privileged access.

name: Developer / Debug Tools
contract: Deterministic authoring/RNG/state tools and reproducible regressions isolated from competitive and economy authority.

name: Public API / Data Layer
contract: If selected: versioned audience-specific schemas, auth/quotas/docs and signed retried safe webhooks.
